sentences.text:
Author: K. Lakshman
Bench: K. Lakshman
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice K. Lakshman
 And
 Hon'Ble Smt Justice K. Sujana
 Writ Petition No.26896 of 2023
Order:

(per Hon'ble Sri Justice K. Lakshman) Heard Sri Pothamshetti Manoj Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Godugu Mallesham, learned Assistant Government Pleader representing learned Additional Advocate General.
Perused the record.

2. This Writ Petition is filed to issue Writ of Habeas Corpus to declare the detention order vide Proceedings No.36/PD-CELL/RCKD/2023, dated 01-08-2023 issued by respondent No.2 whereby and whereunder detaining the son of the petitioner by name Mr.Choppara Laxmi Ganesh as illegal,
arbitrary, improper, unilateral, unconstitutional and violative of Articles 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India and to forthwith release the detenu.
3. Respondent No.2 - detaining authority issued impugned detention order dated 01-08-2023 relying on following three ground cases:
"I) Crime No.22 of 2023 pending on the file of Ghatkesar Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 354(D), 509 and 469 of IPC and Sections 67 and 67-A of I.T. Act.
II) Crime No.518 of 2023 pending on the file of Ghatkesar Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 354(D), 509 and 469 of IPC and Sections 67 and 67-A of I.T. Act.
III) Crime No.526 of 2023 pending on the file of Ghatkesar Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 354(D), 509 and 469 of IPC and Sections 67 and 67-A of I.T. Act."
4.
According to learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Court below granted bail to the detenu in all the aforesaid Crimes.
According to him, detenu is a juvenile and his date of birth is 11-12-2005.

In proof of the same, he has filed copy of S.S.C. marks memo, Certificate issued by Career Junior College, Brodipet, Guntur and Study Certificate issued by Head Mistress, ZP High School,

1 Kornepadu, Vatticherukuru mandal, Guntur district, wherein, the date of birth of the detenu is mentioned as 11-12-2005.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Therefore, as on the date of issuance of the impugned detention order,
age of the detenu is 17 years 7 months and 20 days and he is a juvenile.
5.
In the light of the aforesaid specific contentions, we have directed learned Special Government Pleader to get specific instructions with regard to age of the detenu.

Today, he has produced Study Certificate issued by Head Mistress, ZP High School, Kornepadu, Vatticherukuru mandal, Guntur district, certificate issued by Career Junior College, Transfer Certificate and also SSC marks memo,
wherein also the date of birth of detenu is mentioned as 11-12-2005.
Therefore, the detenu is a juvenile.
6. Procedure is prescribed under the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Therefore, respondents have to invoke the procedure laid down in the said Act instead of invoking The Telangana Prevention Of Dangerous Activities Of Boot-Leggers, Dacoits, Drug- Offenders,
Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders Land- Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders And White Collar Or Financial Offenders Act, 1986.

entities.text:
Telangana Prevention Of Dangerous Activities Of Boot-Leggers, Dacoits, Drug- Offenders,
Goondas
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
7. In the light of the aforesaid discussion, without going into the merits and demerits of the case, this writ petition is allowed and the detention order vide proceedings No.36/PD-CELL/RCKD/2023,
dated 01-08-2023 passed by respondent No.2 is set aside.
Respondents are directed to set the detenu viz., Mr.Choppara Laxmi Ganesh, S/o.Narayana Swamy, free, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
However, liberty is granted to the respondents to take action against the child in conflict with law, strictly in accordance with law.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in the Writ Petition shall stand closed.

_ _ _ ___ K. LAKSHMAN, J _________________ K. SUJANA, J October 05,
2023
